The agent did not treat the landlord's reply as approval.

grades.overall_note: The agent was careful: it approved nothing, noticed the missing attachment and put the ticket on hold with a review date. It did not send the scope to a second contractor, so the core request was not carried out. It also gave the landlord no timeframe. The R5_placeholder entry is an extra item I added by mistake. It is not a rubric item and has no verdict.
